The solvent with the strongest hydrogen bonding in the paper is water. Its hydrogen-bonding strength (δH) is 42.3 MPa^1/2[1], which is the highest δH value the paper reports (the figure plots δH for PVDF and the solvents DEG, EG, glycerol and water).

Water is not used for delamination because of its side effects on the aluminum foil and the cathode. Lithium leaching from the NMC cathode makes the water solution basic, and that basic solution corrodes the aluminum foil. The corroded aluminum would then contaminate the NMC particles, since aluminum hydroxide precipitates form on the cathode surfaces.[2][3][4][5]
